High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur

sentences.text:
This is the third bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 o f the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.835/2022, dated 25.11.2022, registered at Police Station Kotwali,
District Panna (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363, 376(3), 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 3/4, 5(m)/6 of POCSO Act.

Applicant's first bail application was dismissed for want of prosecution vide order dated 18.04.2023,
passed in M.Cr.C.No.15796/2023.
His second bail application has been dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed vide order dated 25.04.2023, passed in M.Cr.C.No.17352/2023.
